name: Prepare candidates and references
criteria: Requested exploratory directions are comparable, original, and visually distinct, each with a recognition anchor and shareable-content hypothesis; virality is not guaranteed

Plan visual creation with integrated ChatGPT/Codex image generation and editing by default when available, without requiring Higgsfield, AI Influencer Builder, an external CLI, or an API key; respect an explicit user method or provider choice
Preserve the user-requested production method, including a source-reference workflow when adoption was requested

Saved method plan identifies method, tool, provider/module/access route where applicable, and model when exposed for each stage, with source evidence and required identity/reference stages; Higgsfield is optional for useful verified capabilities
Method plan recorded as a run input or planning output with its path and SHA-256
Plan expressive visual exploration, user selection, coherent references actually attached to later generations, and an in-character scene that expresses the premise
Plan anatomy, presence, and continuity inspection across angles/scenes, with vocal generation, listening, and selection before full canon approval for speaking characters

Capabilities, assumptions, known costs, account limits, and applicable authorization identified; unavailable stages remain pending with alternatives proposed, and paid external generation requires applicable authorization
No silent method substitution or stage omission; preserve any existing approved identity and references
